stake_concentration.caveat: Validator account IDs are not verified beneficial-owner identities; one operator can control multiple accounts and one account can aggregate delegators.

conclusion_reasons: Assumed annual net monetary change is 10000000 NEAR; this is scenario arithmetic, not an observed gross-issuance measurement.
Illustrative working-capital inventory is 285714.28571429 NEAR under the selected capture and holding-duration assumptions.
The available historical series shows a net supply change of 2566919.04470298 NEAR from oldest to newest point; it does not separate issuance from burns.
limits: Settlement activity is not protocol revenue, burn, token-holder cash flow, or proof that users hold NEAR.
The working-capital output is an inventory scenario, not a price target or complete token valuation.
Staking rewards are protocol issuance to participants and are not automatically external revenue.
Validator-account concentration does not identify unique beneficial operators.

claims.title: Current assumptions do not make usage equal value capture
claims.statement: The scenario produces 10000000 NEAR of annual net monetary change. Activity strengthens the thesis only when a measured mechanism converts it into persistent NEAR inventory or actual protocol burn.
claims.formula: annual net monetary change = assumed gross issuance − assumed actual protocol burn
claims.uncertainty: The current public snapshot measures net supply and execution burn fields; it does not independently decompose all gross issuance and burn categories.
claims.counterargument: Protocol configuration places a ceiling on inflation and actual realized issuance may be lower; product-level buybacks may create demand outside base-protocol burn.
claims.falsification_condition: Over a rolling 90-day window, independently reconciled actual burns and retained token purchases fail to approach observed net issuance.

claims.title: Holding duration is the bridge between settlement and token inventory
claims.statement: The selected settlement, capture, duration, and price assumptions imply 285714.28571429 NEAR of illustrative working-capital inventory.
claims.formula: (daily relevant settlement USD × NEAR-held fraction × holding days) ÷ assumed NEAR price USD
claims.uncertainty: The scenario does not establish that NearBlocks transaction volume is the relevant settlement volume or that any selected fraction is held in NEAR.
claims.counterargument: Users and solvers can settle rapidly, use alternate assets, or source NEAR just in time, collapsing holding duration.
claims.falsification_condition: For 90 days, measured median NEAR inventory duration attributable to settlement remains below the selected threshold or cannot be linked to activity.

claims.title: Validator-account concentration is measurable, operator concentration is not
claims.statement: 27 validator accounts reach the selected 0.67 stake threshold.
claims.formula: sort current validator accounts by stake; accumulate until threshold × total current validator stake
claims.uncertainty: Validator account IDs are not verified beneficial-owner identities; one operator can control multiple accounts and one account can aggregate delegators.
claims.counterargument: Delegation and common beneficial ownership can make account-level concentration understate or overstate operational concentration.
claims.falsification_condition: A verified operator mapping materially changes the threshold account count or top-10 concentration.

notes: Mainnet history and bounded execution outcomes provide reproducible observations. The selected base scenario is neutral: net supply growth and assumed positive issuance do not establish durable token demand. Persistent demand requires independently measured capture and inventory holding. These settlement and burn quantities are scenario assumptions. No AI inference was requested for this report.
